case_envelope.common: id, rule, major, surface, class, construction, input, expected
case_envelope.typed_text: operations_json and cast_arguments_json are JSON text; a runner decodes them with its own tag-preserving BAP JSON decoder (a fraction or exponent marks a float)

class_mapping: a case the rule rejects is invalid_selector; every other case is valid
rule: verification (contract-majors 1, 2 and 3): grant decode rejects an equals value or one_of member that holds a float-tagged number equal to zero at any depth, whatever its sign or spelling; range bounds and inert all members are unchanged
producers (contract-majors 1, 2 and 3): grant_signing_input refuses any float-tagged integral selector value, including the contract-major 2 and 3 range bounds
verdict_source: the rule text and each case's construction; envelope signatures come from ephemeral keys discarded at minting
